Chapter 746: Chapter 31: Cross This Line and Die (Please Subscribe)

“`

“The Heavenly Gate, the Heavenly Gate has appeared.”

“This is the Heavenly Gate. I feel the entire Two-dimensional World is trembling.”

“I now believe that through the Heavenly Gate, one can truly leave this world…”

At the mountainside, many of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses were visibly excited, staring intently at the sky above the mountaintop,

where, under the surging force of space, a ‘Heavenly Gate’ over ten meters tall was gradually taking shape from its ethereal beginnings.

...

“Heavenly Gate?”

The Four Divine Kings’ gaze was solemn, and even though he considered himself invincible in the Two-dimensional World, he was somewhat nervous now.

The Heavenly Gate was critical to whether he could leave. Other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who stayed in the Two-dimensional World paid the price by losing part of their Spirit Will.

But for him, the Four Divine Kings, if he couldn’t return to the universe, he would lose not only part of his Spirit Will but an Ultimate Weapon as well.

Even for a Supreme Being, obtaining an Ultimate Weapon that completely suited oneself was no easy feat.

And what about him, the Four Divine Kings?

If he were to lose this Ultimate Weapon in the Two-dimensional World, the Four Divine Kings would probably have to wait until he became a Supreme Being to obtain another suitable Ultimate Weapon.

But how long would that take?

And there was no guarantee for the Four Divine Kings to become Ultimate, to achieve Ascendancy.

Otherwise, he wouldn’t have been dragging his feet until now.

“I will be the one to enter the Heavenly Gate this time!” The Four Divine Kings’ expression was fierce, and between his four arms, an indistinct mysterious power was circulating.

…

“Is that the Heavenly Gate?”

From afar, Lin Yuan was also observing the Heavenly Gate, “What a massive spatial fluctuation!”

Lin Yuan was astonished in his heart. The spatial fluctuation emitted by the silver mirror paled in comparison to the Heavenly Gate before him – it was like the light of a glowworm against the bright moon.

The two were not on the same level at all.

“To leave the Two-dimensional World, one must rely on the Heavenly Gate.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself that it was absolutely impossible for an individual alone to cause such a huge disturbance in the force of space.

…

Outside the scroll.

Just as the Heavenly Gate was gradually becoming more tangible.

Dozens of Supreme Beings were on high alert, anticipating that if the Heavenly Gate was the portal connecting the Two-dimensional World with the Main Universe,

then when the Heavenly Gate appeared, the Two-dimensional World, severed by ‘White Paper,’ would establish a conduit to the Main Universe.

At that time, they, the Supreme Beings, could better observe the essence of ‘White Paper.’

They could even interfere with the Two-dimensional World.

For example, forcefully ‘fishing out’ the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who were deeply trapped within?

With the barrier of White Paper, the Supreme Beings couldn’t affect the inside of the Two-dimensional World.

But if a connection were established, with the methods of a Supreme Being, ‘fishing people out’ would be entirely doable.

However,

a moment later,

the faces of the Supreme Beings outside the scroll turned ugly.

“What’s going on?”

“Why has the Heavenly Gate inside started to materialize, but there is still no change in the outside world?”

“Based on the clan’s reports, when the Heavenly Gate materializes, there is a massive fluctuation of spatial force. It’s clearly the characteristic of establishing a spatial passage, so why is there no response from the outside now?”

Each of the Supreme Beings looked puzzled.

Normally, with a spatial passage, if one side experiences a spatial fluctuation, the other side should as well, otherwise how could they connect?

“Did something unexpected happen?”

“Let’s wait a bit longer. Perhaps it’s because the Heavenly Gate hasn’t fully manifested, so it hasn’t affected the outside world yet.”

“Yes, let’s keep waiting. Once the Heavenly Gate is completely formed, it should be about time.”

Many Supreme Beings exchanged glances and patiently began to wait again.

Having lived through long eons, what they didn’t lack was patience.

…

At the summit of Heavenly Mountain.

Just as the Heavenly Gate was gradually taking shape.

The Four Divine Kings and five other Eleventh Rank Perfect Legendary Lives suddenly charged toward the Heavenly Gate.

Boom boom boom.

Terrible sonic booms reverberated in all directions.

In just a blink of an eye, the Four Divine Kings had exchanged hundreds of blows with the five other Eleventh Rank Perfect Lives.

“We must take down the Four Divine Kings first.”

The gaunt old man and the other four looked at each other and joined forces, pressing down towards the Four Divine Kings.

In their eyes, the Four Divine Kings posed too great a threat. Keeping the Four Divine Kings would only allow them to pick the spoils after the others had battled.

“You want to take me down first?”

“You are not worthy!”

The Four Divine Kings laughed madly, his four arms swirling with dense vital energy.

Rip.

The Four Divine Kings’ arms were incredibly nimble, lightly reaching out and landing on the chest of the three-meter-tall burly man.

This three-meter-tall burly man was also an Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Life. His expression changed drastically as he began to retreat explosively, only stopping after a hundred meters.

Swoosh.

The figure of the three-meter-tall burly man disappeared, rejoining the battle against the Four Divine Kings.

Whir whir whir.

Accompanied by the ferocious combat of the Four Divine Kings and the gaunt old man with the other four powerhouses, their terrifying attacks had almost ‘plowed’ through the entire summit of the Heavenly Mountain.

…

“They’re too strong.”

“How can the Four Divine Kings be so strong?”

At the top of the summit, over a hundred Eleventh Rank Powerhouses, who had initially planned to get closer to the Heavenly Gate and perhaps sneak some benefits,

but after seeing the exchange between the Four Divine Kings and the other five powerhouses, didn’t dare to approach.

Anyone who dared approach the Heavenly Gate at this moment would become the target of the Four Divine Kings and those five powerhouses. The outcome would almost be certain death; not even a defense artifact could keep them alive.

A defense artifact might block ninety-nine percent of the attacks, but the residual shockwave penetration was enough to annihilate any of the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses.

“Damn it…”

At the central position close to the mountaintop, Hou Zhu of the Prison Tribe, wielding a blood-red long knife, was filled with reluctance.

“`

He was one of the few strong contenders from the Myriad Tribes who dared to bring a mysterious artifact into the fray.

But Hou Zhu did not carry the strange object directly with him. His blood-colored long knife was placed inside a wooden box, and outsiders did not know what was inside.

Originally, Hou Zhu had planned to make a great show with the blood-colored long knife when approaching the Heavenly Gate. Yet, at the moment, he could not even get close to the battlefield of the Four Divine Kings and Bosan.

…

At the mountain base.

Over a hundred thousand powerhouses from the Myriad Clans watched the battle between the Four Divine Kings and the other five strong contenders in utter shock.

“In this Two-dimensional World, they can exert such strength; aren’t the Four Divine Kings too freakish?”

“Thank goodness I came down from the mountain prematurely. Otherwise, I would have been gravely injured by the aftermath of their clash, if not dead.”

“Alas, it seems I have no chance to enter the Heavenly Gate now. The Four Divine Kings and those five contenders have already occupied the six spots for the opening of the Heavenly Gate. I can’t possibly live for seventy thousand years in this Two-dimensional World…”

…

While watching the battle, an air of desperation began to surge in the hearts of many powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes.

Even a small proportion of them directly extinguished their avatars,

Since they were to suffer essential losses sooner or later, they might as well face it now.

…

On the side of Human Civilization.

Xuanyuan Dua and the other Evolvers watched the battle under the Heavenly Gate with trepidation.

“Lord Xueyu, should we give up this opportunity for the opening of the Heavenly Gate?” Xuanyuan Dua couldn’t help but ask, truly frightened by the scene of the confrontation between the Four Divine Kings and the other strong contenders.

“Let’s wait and see,” Lin Yuan said nonchalantly.

So far, the Four Divine Kings had yet to use their ultimate weapon.

The fighting between the six contenders looked extremely brutal,

but neither side had truly exerted their full power yet.

The five Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives, led by the small and thin old man, had also not yet used a single mysterious artifact.

…

Under the Heavenly Gate.

“Huff! Huff!”

Six figures were fighting fiercely.

“The Heavenly Gate is about to materialize.”

“You four join forces and hold him off; I’ll go check out the Heavenly Gate.”

The small and thin old man quickly broke away, intending to head towards the Heavenly Gate.

According to the information within the Two-dimensional World, only the life that stands in front of the Heavenly Gate first after it opens can attempt to push it.

This meant that it was not directly related to strength,

Even though the individual strength of the Four Divine Kings was the strongest, as long as they did not stand in front of the Heavenly Gate, there was a chance that the small and thin old man could enter it.

“How dare you?”

The Four Divine Kings instantly went mad.

A dimly luminous light suddenly appeared between his four arms, and an aura that shook the soul momentarily covered the entire mountain summit.

“The Four Divine Kings are using that ultimate weapon.”

The small and thin old man, who had originally intended to approach the Heavenly Gate, immediately returned.

His actions just now were solely to provoke the Four Divine Kings, forcing them to use their ultimate weapon prematurely.

If the Four Divine Kings had endured a little longer and allowed the small and thin old man to approach the Heavenly Gate, the other four Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Lives would probably have been unable to sit still.

Boom!

A terrifying aura suddenly exploded. The small and thin old man and the other five strong contenders also used their mysterious artifacts for the first time.

In an instant, the battle beneath the Heavenly Gate escalated several levels, with the horrifying aftermath almost continuously eroding the height of the mountain summit.

“Hahahaha, you five useless things, you think you can deal with me by joining forces?”

The Four Divine Kings waved their four arms, and every attack they launched shook the five Eleventh Rank Complete Legendary Strength contenders.

“He’s so strong?”

The small and thin old man looked troubled but did not back down.

The Heavenly Gate was right before his eyes; unless absolutely necessary, he was unwilling to give up.

Now, the Four Divine Kings were facing five at once and had the upper hand, but that didn’t mean they could definitely beat them.

Boom!

The energy of the small and thin old man and the other five contenders surged once more, repelling the Four Divine Kings’ frenzied attacks.

…

“Let’s go.”

“We can’t stay here any longer.”

“Hurry, let’s go.”

The Eleventh Rank Powerhouses standing on the summit began to rush towards the middle of the mountain.

They felt that if they continued to stay there, they might indeed be in mortal danger.

“Lord Xueyu, we should also leave quickly,” Xuanyuan Dua said urgently. Their ability to withstand the pressure emanating from the Four Divine Kings and the others was solely due to Lin Yuan’s protection.

Most human Evolvers did not have the right to stand at the top of the mountain,

and now that the fight between the Four Divine Kings and the other five contenders had escalated, it would be suicidal not to leave.

“Leave?”

“Why should we leave?”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, his gaze still fixed on the Heavenly Gate, which had mostly materialized, “I originally thought that a refined ultimate weapon could unleash considerable power in this world. Turns out it’s just this…”

“What do you mean?” Xuanyuan Dua was somewhat baffled. She did not understand why at this moment, instead of worrying about evading the aftermath, Lord Xueyu was talking about the power of the ultimate weapon?

However,

before Xuanyuan Dua could recover her wits, Lin Yuan, who had been standing in front of her, casually stepped forward and vanished from the spot.

…

Beneath the Heavenly Gate, where the Four Divine Kings and the small and thin old man and other contenders had been fiercely colliding, suddenly everyone felt their scalps explode, as if they were facing life-and-death decisions, and fear arose in their hearts. They started to retreat wildly in all directions without hesitation.

Swish.

A figure crossed over their former positions and appeared in front of the barely manifested Heavenly Gate.

This figure, with his back to the Four Divine Kings and the other six strong contenders, raised his right hand and gently drew a line behind him.

A constantly trembling black aura encompassed half of the mountain summit, and the Four Divine Kings and the other six strong contenders were all outside this thin line of black energy.

It was only then that Lin Yuan even glanced at the Four Divine Kings and the others.

“Cross this line and die!”
